ELON MUSK’S ICONIC APRIL FOOLS’ JOKE THAT HAD THE WHOLE WORLD PANICKING

On April 1, 2018, Elon Musk dropped one of the greatest April Fools’ pranks in tech history.

He posted that Tesla had gone completely and totally bankrupt — complete with a photo of him literally sleeping on the factory floor, looking exhausted.

The caption?

“On the floor of the factory, wondering what to do next.”

At the time, Tesla was in the middle of brutal “production hell” trying to ramp up the Model 3. Cash was running dangerously low, and many analysts were genuinely predicting bankruptcy. 

The joke was so believable that the stock dropped hard before people realized it was April 1st.

But here’s what made it legendary:

•  It was classic Elon humor — turning a very real near-death moment into self-deprecating comedy.
•  It showed the insane pressure he was under while still pushing forward.
•  It proved once again that he refuses to let the world see him sweat… even when the company was on the brink.

Tesla didn’t go bankrupt.

Instead, it survived, scaled, and became the most valuable car company on Earth.

That single post is now remembered as one of the most iconic moments in Tesla history — a perfect example of Elon’s ability to laugh in the face of extreme adversity.
